subject.statement: Trevor Milton is currently serving a prison sentence for fraud.

summary: Trevor Milton was convicted of securities and wire fraud in October 2022 and sentenced to approximately four years in prison in early 2023. Assuming a standard sentence with no early release, he would still be incarcerated as of October 2026.
